hunks.baseline: Clouds carrying January’s chill swept past before his eyes, so close he could almost reach out and touch them. Far below, buildings and plazas divided into neat districts spread across the ground.
hunks.sol: Clouds carrying January’s chill swept past, so close he could almost touch them. Far below, he could make out buildings and plazas laid out in separate districts.

hunks.baseline: The view of a great city steeped in history. Countless people moved below, reduced to tiny dots within the city.
hunks.sol: A great city steeped in history. Countless people moved through it, reduced to tiny dots.

hunks.baseline: The gloomy gray sky and streets submerged in mist were hardly a sight befitting Paris, the City of Light. But the middle-aged man did not care.
hunks.sol: The gloomy gray sky and mist-shrouded streets hardly suited Paris’s name, the City of Light. But the middle-aged man didn’t care.

hunks.baseline: He loved everything about this city—about Paris.
hunks.sol: He loved everything about this city.

hunks.baseline: The world viewed from a skyscraper too high for even the mist to reach was always beautiful.
hunks.sol: From a skyscraper too high for even the mist to reach, the world was always beautiful.

hunks.baseline: Especially on a day like this.
hunks.sol: Especially on a day like today.

hunks.baseline: The bells ringing out across the plaza announced seven in the morning. The middle-aged man tore his gaze from the windows covering one wall and slowly turned around.
hunks.sol: Bells rang out across the plaza, announcing seven in the morning. The middle-aged man turned slowly from the wall of windows.

hunks.baseline: It was a massive study.
hunks.sol: Behind him lay a vast study.

hunks.baseline: At the round table in its center, over ten figures waited for him, appearing amid the green glow unique to holograms.
hunks.sol: At the round table in its center, a dozen or so figures waited amid the green glow of holograms.

hunks.baseline: “It’s been a long time since we gathered in one place like this. The last meeting was probably… three years ago?”
hunks.sol: “It’s been a long time since we all gathered like this. Our last meeting was, what… three years ago?”

hunks.baseline: The corners of the people’s mouths, visible beneath their masks, curled slightly at the joke the middle-aged man made as soon as he took the seat of honor.
hunks.sol: As soon as he took the seat of honor, the corners of the mouths visible beneath their masks curled at his joke.

hunks.baseline: They had held a secret meeting only two nights ago.
hunks.sol: They had held a secret meeting just two nights ago.

hunks.baseline: —If I remember correctly, the last one was ten years ago.
hunks.sol: —If I remember correctly, it was ten years ago.

hunks.baseline: —Ten years? Has it really been that long?
hunks.sol: —Ten years? Already?

hunks.baseline: —Wasn’t it more like thirty years ago?
hunks.sol: —Wasn’t it closer to thirty?

hunks.baseline: —Damn it. Thirty years ago was the Great Cataclysm. I don’t even want to remember the hell we went through, so drop it.
hunks.sol: —Damn it. Thirty years ago was the Great Cataclysm. I don’t want to remember the hell we went through. Drop it.

hunks.baseline: Quiet laughter mingled with the conversation passing back and forth.
hunks.sol: Quiet laughter mingled with their conversation.

hunks.baseline: Watching them, the middle-aged man smiled gently.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man watched them with a gentle smile.

hunks.baseline: “You all seem remarkably relaxed. Still, it is nice to exchange this sort of idle chatter once in a while.”
hunks.sol: “You all seem to be in good spirits. Yes, it’s nice to indulge in idle chatter now and then.”

hunks.baseline: Silence descended with that quiet remark.
hunks.sol: Silence fell at his quiet words.

hunks.baseline: The people who had all fallen silent at the same time, as if they had made an agreement beforehand, looked toward him. The middle-aged man continued speaking with a smile on his face.
hunks.sol: They all closed their mouths at once, as though on cue. Still smiling, the middle-aged man went on.

hunks.baseline: “I did not call this meeting to listen to pointless nonsense or trashy small talk like this… What does everyone think?”
hunks.sol: “But I didn’t call this meeting to listen to worthless nonsense and trashy small talk. What do you think?”

hunks.baseline: The people’s eyes wavered at the slightest sound of his breathing or the smallest movement of his fingertips.
hunks.sol: Their eyes wavered at each breath he took, each slight movement of his fingertips.

hunks.baseline: His overwhelming presence came through despite the hologram. So did his aura.
hunks.sol: Even through a hologram, his overwhelming presence—and his aura—reached them.

hunks.baseline: Every person attending the meeting was a major figure, yet none of them could hope to rival the middle-aged man.
hunks.sol: Everyone at the meeting was a major figure. None could hope to rival him.

hunks.baseline: The man before them was the master of Odin Guild, known as the greatest Guild in the world, and one of the absolute beings capable of controlling the world.
hunks.sol: He was Michael, master of Odin Guild, the greatest Guild in the world, and one of the few people with the power to bend that world to his will.

hunks.baseline: —I-I apologize, Michael. I was simply pleased that everything was proceeding without a hitch…
hunks.sol: —I-I apologize, Michael. I was pleased that everything was proceeding without a hitch, and…

hunks.baseline: “I did not say that to hear excuses.”
hunks.sol: “I wasn’t asking for excuses.”

hunks.baseline: Michael cut the person off and continued.
hunks.sol: Michael cut him off.

hunks.baseline: “It only seemed absurd to see you all acting as though everything were already over.”
hunks.sol: “I simply found it pathetic to see you all relaxing as though everything were over.”

hunks.baseline: “Our opponent is more daring than expected. Otherwise, could they have carried out such a lunatic act?”
hunks.sol: “Our opponent is more daring than we expected. How else could they have done something so insane?”

hunks.baseline: There was not a single person in the room who did not know what that “lunatic act” referred to. No—the entire world knew by now.
hunks.sol: No one at the table needed to ask what he meant. By now, the whole world knew.

hunks.baseline: Making the Mana Cultivation Method public.
hunks.sol: The public release of the Mana Cultivation Method.

hunks.baseline: To a tiny number of people, it was madness capable of destroying the established order. But their opponent had turned that madness into reality.
hunks.sol: To a tiny number of people, it was an act of madness that threatened to overturn the established order. Their opponent had made it happen anyway.

hunks.baseline: “I sent Huginn, but they still refused to listen. Unbelievably reckless… though I suppose that means they’re just that confident.”
hunks.sol: “I sent Huginn, and they still didn’t get the message. Reckless beyond belief… but I suppose that means they’re confident.”

hunks.baseline: One person cautiously opened their mouth.
hunks.sol: One of them spoke cautiously.

hunks.baseline: —If—just hypothetically—the one they’re counting on is Sky…
hunks.sol: —If, hypothetically, they’re counting on Sky…

hunks.baseline: “I believe I already said that you need not concern yourselves with that matter.”
hunks.sol: “I believe I already told you not to concern yourselves with him.”

hunks.baseline: The answer was not entirely convincing.
hunks.sol: The reply lacked conviction.

hunks.baseline: Until now, Michael’s word had been law to all of them.
hunks.sol: Until now, Michael’s word had been law to every one of them. If he spoke with such certainty, any lingering doubts had to be buried deep.

hunks.baseline: Once he had spoken with such certainty, they had no choice but to dig a hole for any lingering doubts deep in their hearts and bury them there.
But this time, every one of them could not help turning the question over in their minds.
hunks.sol: But this time, none of them could stop turning the question over.

hunks.baseline: Because the person in question was none other than Cheon Taemin.
hunks.sol: The man in question was Cheon Taemin.

hunks.baseline: *Even so, how can he tell us not to worry about a matter this serious?*
hunks.sol: *Even so, how can he tell us not to worry about something this serious?*

hunks.baseline: *If Sky gets involved, what will happen then?*
hunks.sol: *What happens if Sky gets involved?*

hunks.baseline: *What kind of information does he have to be so certain…?*
hunks.sol: *Where did he get his information…?*

hunks.baseline: The thoughts continued to circle endlessly through their minds.
hunks.sol: The questions kept circling through their minds.

hunks.baseline: Michael’s information had always been reliable. No one knew who provided it or what methods he used to obtain it, but as long as they trusted and acted on the information he brought them, they profited.
hunks.sol: Michael’s information had always been reliable. No one knew who supplied it or how he obtained it, but trusting it had brought them immense wealth, fame, and lofty social standing.

hunks.baseline: Immense wealth and fame. Lofty social status.

hunks.baseline: But no matter how strong and high a fortress was, it could collapse in an instant.
hunks.sol: Yet even the highest, strongest wall could fall in an instant.

hunks.baseline: And the name Cheon Taemin was not something they could simply bury through faith. The sense of crisis they felt was conveyed in its entirety to one person.
hunks.sol: Cheon Taemin was not a name they could set aside on faith alone. And one man sensed their unease.

hunks.baseline: Fingers slowly tapped against the round table. At the same time, those who felt the waves of powerful mana shook off their thoughts and returned to reality.
hunks.sol: A finger drummed slowly on the round table. Waves of powerful mana rolled over them, pulling them from their thoughts.

hunks.baseline: At the gentle voice, the people hurried to answer.
hunks.sol: They hurried to answer his gentle voice.

hunks.baseline: —Our alliance is powerful. There is no way we could lose to brats like them.
hunks.sol: —Our alliance is powerful. We won’t lose to brats like them.

hunks.baseline: They swallowed the needless addition: *if only Cheon Taemin were not involved.*
hunks.sol: They kept the qualification to themselves: *As long as Cheon Taemin stays out of it.*

hunks.baseline: For now, they could only trust Michael. Judging by the power and ability he had shown them all this time, those mere fledglings would not be opponents at all, just as one of them had said.
hunks.sol: For now, they had no choice but to trust Michael. Given the power and ability he had shown them, those brats would be no match for him.

hunks.baseline: —Choi’s resourcefulness is impressive, but his limitations are equally clear.
hunks.sol: —Choi is remarkably capable for his age, but he has clear limits.

hunks.baseline: —The same goes for Jin Taekyung. No matter how strong he is, he cannot break through the walls we have built.
hunks.sol: —The same goes for Jin Taekyung. However strong he is, he can’t get past the walls we’ve built.

hunks.baseline: There had certainly been a time when such a thing was possible.
hunks.sol: There had been a time when that might have been possible.

hunks.baseline: It was a turbulent period when nothing seemed strange, no matter what happened.
hunks.sol: In those turbulent years, nothing would have seemed impossible.

hunks.baseline: But the Great Cataclysm had ended.
hunks.sol: But the Great Cataclysm was over.

hunks.baseline: On a sea lashed by storms, nothing that happened would seem strange. But in a peaceful world like this one, even a ripple could not cause meaningful change.
hunks.sol: Anything could happen on a storm-tossed sea. In a peaceful world like this one, a mere ripple could not bring about change.

hunks.baseline: The Mana Cultivation Method revealed this time was no different.
hunks.sol: The Mana Cultivation Method they had released was no different.

hunks.baseline: —By making the Mana Cultivation Method public, they have caused us enormous losses as well… But the immediate crisis has been dealt with, so there is no reason for concern.
hunks.sol: —Their decision to make the Mana Cultivation Method public has cost us dearly. But we’ve dealt with the immediate crisis. There’s no reason to worry.

hunks.baseline: —Exactly. In the end, even the media did not dare criticize us. Above all, it was thanks to your swift action, Guild Master.
hunks.sol: —Exactly. The media didn’t dare criticize us, and above all, you acted quickly, Guild Master.

hunks.baseline: Michael silently nodded.
hunks.sol: Michael nodded without a word.

hunks.baseline: The news about the Mana Cultivation Method, released in Odin Guild’s name at sunrise, was spreading across the world through all kinds of media even now.
hunks.sol: News of the Mana Cultivation Method Odin Guild had unveiled at sunrise was even now spreading across the world through every kind of media.

hunks.baseline: The public criticism aimed at the established major Guilds would gradually die down, and the fledglings who had ignored his generous offer would soon regret it.
hunks.sol: Public criticism of the established major Guilds would gradually die down. And the fledglings who had ignored his generous offer would soon regret it.

hunks.baseline: This time, he would not settle for words. He would show them directly through his actions.
hunks.sol: His next warning would come not in words, but in action.

hunks.baseline: *How foolish.*
hunks.sol: *Fools.*

hunks.baseline: Michael muttered inwardly.

hunks.baseline: In this world, the Mana Cultivation Method was a treasure beyond calculation.
At a time when a Guild’s standing and a nation’s influence depended on how many powerful Hunters they possessed, those fools had revealed it to the entire world.
hunks.sol: In today’s world, a Mana Cultivation Method was a treasure beyond price. A Guild’s standing and a nation’s influence depended on the strength of their Hunters, yet those fools had given one away to the entire world.

hunks.baseline: *They should have thought it through first. Why do they think there has never been a precedent for something like this?*
hunks.sol: *They should have asked themselves why no one had ever done it before.*

hunks.baseline: There had been fools in the past who stepped forward armed only with morality and a sense of justice.
hunks.sol: Others had stepped forward in the past, armed with nothing but morality and a sense of justice. Powerful people recognized around the world, they had wanted to share their special abilities with everyone.

hunks.sol: That was why they had died.

hunks.baseline: *And the result will be the same this time.*
hunks.sol: *And this time will end the same way.*

hunks.baseline: Although the Mana Cultivation Method had been made public because of their opponent’s unexpected and impulsive act, they would have to pay the price for their foolishness.
hunks.sol: Their opponent’s unexpected move had put the Mana Cultivation Method out into the world, but they would pay for their foolishness.

hunks.baseline: That was the law of this world.
hunks.sol: That was how the world worked.

hunks.baseline: There was only one thing that continued to bother him: the young man who had caused the greatest change in recent times.
hunks.sol: Only one thing troubled him: the young man responsible for the greatest upheaval in recent memory.

hunks.baseline: Unlike Choi Minwoo, whom Michael still considered a fledgling, that bastard was a powerful figure no one could deny.
hunks.sol: Unlike Choi Minwoo, whom Michael still considered a fledgling, Jin Taekyung was undeniably strong.

hunks.baseline: In less than a year, he had piled up countless achievements and a fearsome reputation. Not long ago, he had even brought down the Ares Guild headquarters single-handedly, despite hundreds of Hunters—including Go Jun—waiting there.
hunks.sol: In less than a year, he had amassed countless achievements and considerable fame. Recently, he had brought down Ares Guild’s headquarters single-handedly, despite the hundreds of Hunters waiting there, Go Jun among them.

hunks.baseline: That was not all.
hunks.sol: And that was not all.

hunks.baseline: The world did not know it yet, but Michael knew that Jin Taekyung was the one who had recently swept away terrorist organizations and rebel groups.
hunks.sol: The world didn’t know it yet, but Michael knew Jin Taekyung had recently wiped out terrorist organizations and rebel groups.

hunks.baseline: *Power that ranks among the best even among S-rank Hunters. And daring.*
hunks.sol: *Strength that places him among the best of the S-rank Hunters. And the daring to use it.*

hunks.baseline: It was a realm that not one of the people chattering endlessly before him could ever reach.
hunks.sol: Not one of the people chattering before him could match that.

hunks.baseline: An S-rank Hunter leading a world-class major Guild. A politician who could control a powerful nation. A tycoon who owned hundreds of Gates and oil fields…
hunks.sol: An S-rank Hunter who led a major Guild known around the world. A politician who could sway a powerful nation. A tycoon who owned hundreds of Gates and oil fields…

hunks.baseline: Every one of them was more than worthy of being called a major figure. Yet in Michael’s eyes, they were all nothing more than greedy idiots.
hunks.sol: Every one of them deserved to be called a major figure. To Michael, they were all greedy idiots.

hunks.baseline: *Of course, thanks to that, I was able to raise Odin Guild to the top of the world.*
hunks.sol: *Of course, they’re the reason I was able to make Odin Guild the greatest in the world.*

hunks.baseline: Michael muttered inwardly and clicked his tongue softly.
hunks.sol: Michael clicked his tongue softly.

hunks.baseline: *Tsks.*
hunks.sol: *Tsk.*

hunks.baseline: The endless voices vanished, and everyone’s eyes turned toward him.
hunks.sol: The chatter stopped. Every eye turned to him.

hunks.baseline: Michael studied them one by one. Then, all at once, he sensed someone approaching from far away and opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: He looked over them one by one. Then he sensed someone approaching from a distance.

hunks.baseline: “You seem to have been moving around quite a bit.”

hunks.baseline: “It was a very tight schedule.”

hunks.baseline: “You went a long way. It must have been difficult. Did you encounter any problems?”
hunks.sol: “You traveled a long way. Any problems?”

hunks.baseline: “There were some, but I resolved them.”

hunks.baseline: Despite his curt answer, Huginn’s eyes still burned with the afterglow of battle.

hunks.baseline: Michael nodded without showing any particular reaction.
